```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
set.seed(501322)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MASS)
```

Import Data and Summary Statistics:
```{r}
data <- read_csv("tourism_finaldf.csv")

data$reporter_area_label <- as.factor(data$reporter_area_label)
data$year_f <- as.factor(data$year)

summary(data)
```

Standardizing Dataset, Removing NAs and Railpassengers (NA-heavy column) and Observing Correlation Plots:
```{r}
data_standardized <- data %>%
  mutate(year_s = scale(year)) %>%
  mutate(population_l = scale(population_l)) %>%
  mutate(exchangerate_l = scale(exchangerate_l)) %>%
  mutate(railpassengers_l = scale(railpassengers_l)) %>%
  mutate(gdptotal_l  = scale(gdptotal_l )) %>%
  mutate(gdpgrowthrate_l = scale(gdpgrowthrate_l)) %>%
  mutate(gdppercapita  = scale(gdppercapita )) %>%
  mutate(Airports = scale(Airports)) %>%
  mutate(NumNatParks = scale(NumNatParks)) %>%
  mutate(TotalParkAreaKM = scale(TotalParkAreaKM)) %>%
  mutate(ParkAreaPercent = scale(ParkAreaPercent)) %>%
  mutate(OldestPark = scale(OldestPark)) %>%
  mutate(total_sites_cultural = scale(total_sites_cultural)) %>%
  mutate(total_sites_mixed = scale(total_sites_mixed)) %>%
  mutate(total_sites_natural = scale(total_sites_natural))

data_filtered <- data_standardized |> dplyr::select(-railpassengers_l) %>% drop_na()

library(corrplot)
data_nocountry <- data_filtered %>% dplyr::select(-c(reporter_area_label, year, year_f))
cor_data <- cor(data_nocountry, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
corrplot(cor_data)
heatmap(cor_data, symm = TRUE)
```

Train-Test Split:
```{r}
train_size <- floor(0.80 * nrow(data_filtered))
set.seed(501322)
train_ind <- sample(seq_len(nrow(data_filtered)), size = train_size)

train <- data_filtered[train_ind, ]
test <- data_filtered[-train_ind, ]
```

Elastic Net with Lambda = 0.5 for Variable Refinement:
```{r}
library(glmnet)

x_vars <- data.matrix(data_filtered[, c("reporter_area_label", "year_f", "population_l", "exchangerate_l", "gdptotal_l", "gdpgrowthrate_l", "gdppercapita", "Airports", "NumNatParks", "TotalParkAreaKM", "ParkAreaPercent", "OldestPark", "total_sites_cultural", "total_sites_mixed", "total_sites_natural")])
y_var <- data.matrix(data_filtered[, "value"])

cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(x_vars[train_ind,], y_var[train_ind], alpha = 0.5)
plot(cv_lasso)
best_lambda <- cv_lasso$lambda.min
best_lambda
lasso_model <- glmnet(x_vars[train_ind,], y_var[train_ind], alpha = 0.5, lambda = best_lambda)
coef(lasso_model)
```

Elastic Net Results (drop Total GDP):
```{r}
lasso_best <- glmnet(x_vars[train_ind,], y_var[train_ind], alpha = 0.5, lambda = best_lambda)
lasso_pred <- predict(lasso_best, s = best_lambda, newx = x_vars[-train_ind,])
coef(lasso_best)
```

Baseline Generalized Linear Mixed Model:
```{r}
glmm <- lmer(value ~ year_f + population_l + exchangerate_l + gdpgrowthrate_l + gdppercapita + 
                  Airports + NumNatParks + TotalParkAreaKM + ParkAreaPercent + OldestPark + total_sites_cultural + total_sites_mixed + total_sites_natural + 
                  (1 | reporter_area_label), train)
summary(glmm)
plot(glmm)
qqnorm(resid(glmm))
```

Random Effects of Generalized Linear Mixed Model:
```{r}
ranef_glmm <- ranef(glmm)
ranef_df <- as.data.frame(ranef_glmm)
ranef_selection <- ranef_df %>%
  filter(abs(condval) > 10000)
ggplot(ranef_selection, aes(x = condval, y = reorder(grp, condval))) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = condval - condsd, xmax = condval + condsd), 
                 height = 0, color = "darkgray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Random Effects (Absolute Estimate > 10,000)",
       x = "Random Effect Estimate",
       y = "Country")
```

Box-Cox Analysis of Appropriate Transformation of Visits:
```{r}
boxcox(value ~ year, data = data_standardized, lambda = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.05))
```

Generalized Linear Mixed Model, but with Response Transformed via Logarithm in Response to Box-Cox:
```{r}
log_glmm <- lmer(log(value) ~ year_f + population_l + exchangerate_l + gdpgrowthrate_l + gdppercapita + 
                  Airports + NumNatParks + TotalParkAreaKM + ParkAreaPercent + OldestPark + total_sites_cultural + total_sites_mixed + total_sites_natural + 
                  (1 | reporter_area_label), train)
summary(log_glmm)
plot(log_glmm)
qqnorm(residuals(log_glmm))
```
Laplace Generalized Linear Mixed-Effects Model w/ Poisson Family and Log Link:
```{r}
poisson_glmm <- glmer(value ~ year_f + population_l + exchangerate_l + gdpgrowthrate_l + gdppercapita + 
                  Airports + NumNatParks + TotalParkAreaKM + OldestPark + total_sites_cultural + total_sites_mixed + total_sites_natural + 
                  (1 | reporter_area_label), family = poisson(link = "log"), data = train)

summary(poisson_glmm)
plot(poisson_glmm)
qqnorm(residuals(poisson_glmm))
```

Poisson Mixed Effects
```{r}
ranef_poisson <- ranef(poisson_glmm)
ranef_poisson_df <- as.data.frame(ranef_poisson)
ranef_poisson_selection <- ranef_poisson_df %>%
  filter(abs(condval) > 1)
ggplot(ranef_poisson_selection, aes(x = condval, y = reorder(grp, condval))) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = condval - condsd, xmax = condval + condsd), 
                 height = 0, color = "darkgray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Poisson Random Effects (Absolute Estimate > 1)",
       x = "Random Effect Estimate",
       y = "Country")
```


MCMC Generalized Linear Mixed-Effects Model w/ Poisson Family and Log Link:
```{r}
library(MCMCglmm)
prior_poisson <- list(
  R = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),
  G = list(G1 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002))
)
mcmc <- MCMCglmm(round(value, 0) ~ year_f + population_l + exchangerate_l + gdpgrowthrate_l + gdppercapita + 
                  Airports + NumNatParks + TotalParkAreaKM + OldestPark + total_sites_cultural + total_sites_mixed + total_sites_natural,
                  random = ~reporter_area_label,
                  family = "poisson",
                  data = train, 
                  prior = prior_poisson,
                  nitt = 50000, 
                  burnin = 10000, 
                  thin = 10
                  )
```

Summary and Trace Plots of MCMC Model:
```{r}
summary(mcmc)
par(mar=c(2,2,2,2))
plot(mcmc)
```

Train and Test Predictions:
```{r}
glmm_train_pred <- predict(glmm, newdata = train)
log_glmm_train_pred <- exp(predict(log_glmm, newdata = train))
poisson_train_pred <- exp(predict(poisson_glmm, newdata = train))
mcmc_train_pred <- predict(mcmc, newdata = train)

glmm_test_pred <- predict(glmm, newdata = test)
log_glmm_test_pred <- exp(predict(log_glmm, newdata = test))
poisson_test_pred <- exp(predict(poisson_glmm, newdata = test))
mcmc_test_pred <- predict(mcmc, newdata = test)

glmm_train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train$value - glmm_train_pred)^2))
log_glmm_train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train$value - log_glmm_train_pred)^2))
poisson_train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train$value - poisson_train_pred)^2))
mcmc_train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train$value - mcmc_train_pred)^2))

glmm_test_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$value - glmm_test_pred)^2))
log_glmm_test_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$value - log_glmm_test_pred)^2))
poisson_test_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$value - poisson_test_pred)^2))
mcmc_test_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$value - mcmc_test_pred)^2))
```

Bar Plot of Training RMSEs (Test RMSEs were Infinite...):
```{r}
models <- c(rep("GLMM" , 2) , rep("log(GLMM)" , 2) , rep("Poisson" , 2) , rep("MCMC" , 2) )
tt <- rep(c("train", "test") , 4)
rmse <- c(glmm_train_rmse, glmm_test_rmse, log_glmm_train_rmse, log_glmm_test_rmse, poisson_train_rmse, poisson_test_rmse, mcmc_train_rmse, mcmc_test_rmse)
rmse_data <- data.frame(models, tt, rmse)

rmse_data_select <- rmse_data |> dplyr::filter(tt == "train")
 
ggplot(rmse_data_select, aes(fill=tt, y=rmse, x=models)) + 
    geom_bar(position="dodge", stat="identity")
```

Joining Actual Visitors and Predicted Visitors for Plotting:
```{r}
data_actualvspredicted <- data_filtered |> dplyr::select(c(...1, reporter_area_label, year_f, value))
df_others <- data_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(...1) %>%
  mutate(
    glmm_prediction = predict(glmm, newdata = data_filtered),
    log_glmm_prediction = exp(predict(log_glmm, newdata = data_filtered)),
    poisson_prediction = exp(predict(poisson_glmm, newdata = data_filtered)),
    mcmc_prediction = predict(mcmc, newdata = data_filtered)
  )
data_actualvspredicted_all <- data_actualvspredicted %>%
  left_join(df_others)
```

Long Transformation, 1 Prediction and Actual Per country + Year for all 4 Models:
```{r}
data_actualvspredicted_stats <- data_actualvspredicted_all %>%
  group_by(reporter_area_label) %>%
  summarise(
    value = mean(value),
    glmm = mean(`glmm_prediction`),
    log_glmm = mean(`log_glmm_prediction`),
    poisson = mean(`poisson_prediction`),
    mcmc = mean(`mcmc_prediction`)
  )

data_long_avp_s <- data_actualvspredicted_stats %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(glmm, log_glmm, poisson, mcmc), 
    names_to = "model_type", 
    values_to = "predicted_mean"
  )
```

Scatterplots of Predicted vs. Actual Visitors:
```{r}
library(ggrepel)

ggplot(data_long_avp_s, aes(x = predicted_mean, y = value, label = reporter_area_label, color = model_type, shape = model_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  xlim(0,2000000) +
  ylim(0,2000000) +
  labs(title = "Model Output",
       x = "Predicted Average Annual Visitors (thousands)",
       y = "Actual Average Annual Visitors (thousands)")

ggplot(data_long_avp_s, aes(x = predicted_mean, y = value, label = reporter_area_label, color = model_type, shape = model_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +

  geom_text_repel(size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  theme_minimal() +

ggplot(data_long_avp_s, aes(x = predicted_mean, y = value, label = reporter_area_label, color = model_type, shape = model_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +

  geom_point(size = 2) +
```

```{r}
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`glmm_prediction`, `log_glmm_prediction`, `poisson_prediction`, `mcmc_prediction`),
```
